## Programming Lecture {#sec-05-programming}

### Systems of equations

```{r}
# 2x + y = 5
# x - y = 1
A <- matrix(c(2, 1, 1, -1), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
b <- c(5, 1)
solve(A, b)
```

### Vectors

```{r}
u <- c(1, 2, 3)
v <- c(4, -1, 0)

u + v
2 * u
sum(u * v) # dot product
```

### Matrices

```{r}
M <- matrix(1:6, nrow = 2)
M
t(M) # transpose
```

```{r}
A <- matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 4), nrow = 2)
B <- matrix(c(5, 6, 7, 8), nrow = 2)

A + B
A %*% B # matrix multiplication
```

### Determinants and inverses

```{r}
det(A)
solve(A) # matrix inverse
A %*% solve(A) # should be (close to) the identity matrix
```
